content.query:
DELETE FROM EDS.MBK_RTBKTRANSACTIONMTB WHERE AS_OF_DATE = @Datetoprocess;

INSERT INTO EDS.MBK_RTBKTRANSACTIONMTB
(
    AS_OF_DATE
,   TXN_KEY
,   TXN_ID
,   MBX_APP_ID
,   TXN_TYPE
,   TXN_DATE
,   TXN_AMT
,   CUST_ID
,   FROM_ACCT_LINK_ID
,   FROM_ACCT_NO
,   FROM_ACCT_CCY
,   FROM_ACCT_ALIAS
,   FROM_BANK_ID
,   FROM_BANK_CODE
,   FROM_BANK_NAME
,   TO_ACCT_PAYEE_TYPE
,   TO_ACCT_LINK_ID
,   TO_ACCT_NO
,   TO_ACCT_CCY
,   TO_ACCT_ALIAS
,   TO_BANK_ID
,   TO_BANK_CODE
,   TO_BANK_NAME
,   TO_ACCT_REF1
,   TO_ACCT_REF2
,   TO_ACCT_REF3
,   TO_ACCT_REF4
,   TXN_FIELD1
,   TXN_FIELD2
,   TXN_FIELD3
,   TXN_DETAIL_REF_ID
,   SCHEDULED_TXN_REF_KEY
,   STATUS
,   STATUS_CHANGE_DATE
,   REMARKS
,   XRATE
,   XRATE_EQUIV_AMT
,   TXN_FAILURE_CODE
,   TXN_FAILURE_TEXT
,   FLAGS
,   HOST_REF_NO
,   LOCATION
,   TXN_CHANNEL
,   PURPOSE
,   PCHCSEQ
,	isActive
,	isLatest
,	BNK_CODE
,	SOURCE_CODE
,	FILE_NAME
,	insert_dttm
)

SELECT 
CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) AS AS_OF_DATE
,	TXN_KEY
,   TXN_ID
,   MBX_APP_ID
,   TXN_TYPE
,   TXN_DATE
,   TXN_AMT
,   CUST_ID
,   FROM_ACCT_LINK_ID
,   FROM_ACCT_NO
,   FROM_ACCT_CCY
,   FROM_ACCT_ALIAS
,   FROM_BANK_ID
,   FROM_BANK_CODE
,   FROM_BANK_NAME
,   TO_ACCT_PAYEE_TYPE
,   TO_ACCT_LINK_ID
,   TO_ACCT_NO
,   TO_ACCT_CCY
,   TO_ACCT_ALIAS
,   TO_BANK_ID
,   TO_BANK_CODE
,   TO_BANK_NAME
,   TO_ACCT_REF1
,   TO_ACCT_REF2
,   TO_ACCT_REF3
,   TO_ACCT_REF4
,   TXN_FIELD1
,   TXN_FIELD2
,   TXN_FIELD3
,   TXN_DETAIL_REF_ID
,   SCHEDULED_TXN_REF_KEY
,   STATUS
,   STATUS_CHANGE_DATE
,   REMARKS
,   XRATE
,   XRATE_EQUIV_AMT
,   TXN_FAILURE_CODE
,   TXN_FAILURE_TEXT
,   FLAGS
,   HOST_REF_NO
,   LOCATION
,   TXN_CHANNEL
,   PURPOSE
,   PCHCSEQ
,	1 as isActive
,	1 as isLatest
,	left(FILE_NAME, 5) as BNK_CODE
,	substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as SOURCE_CODE
,	FILE_NAME
,	convert(datetime2,insert_dttm) as insert_dttm
FROM D360.STG_EDS_MBK_RTBKTRANSACTIONMTB
WHERE H = 'D'
